purpose: Targeted review of two published BUB1B noncoding alleles omitted by the protein-altering baseline; coding sites are positive controls.
scope: Historical L001/L002 alignments only. Same biological sample, not independent replication or full four-lane confirmation.

targets.label: BUB1B upstream ss802470619 / rs576524605
targets.selection: Ochiai 2014 PMID 24344301; ClinGen CCID:004299; exact GRCh38 allele independently verified through CA268757149.

targets.label: BUB1B NM_001211.6:c.2386-11A>G
targets.selection: Rio Frio 2010 PMID 21190457; fresh VCV000030279.7 XML verifies GRCh38 coordinate and retains conflicting LP/VUS assertions.

reference_support_policy.quality_fields: GATK BP-resolution reference model GQ >=20 plus explicit all-sites GT/DP; bcftools constrained 0/0 must have min(PL01,PL11)-PL00 >=20. The likelihood gap is not called GQ. Missing caller GQ remains null.
reference_support_policy.meaning: Operational evidence for reference sequence at these SNPs in retained lanes, not a validated clinical negative or exclusion of mosaicism, deletions, or other regulatory alleles.
